title: JFarwell Catamaran Cruise & Island Adventure at Anchor
blurb: Step aboard our private catamaran with your friends, family or colleagues, and get ready for an amazing day. Depart downtown Halifax and sail through the harbour to Wreck Cove, a hidden gem alongside McNabs Island, overlooking Lawlor's and Devil's Islands. Our crew will drop anchor so you can take advantage of everything available - this experience is completely customizable!
